heading: Iinkonzo le sayithi enokuzisebenzisa
withdrawn: Lonke ukhetho lurhoxisiwe. Inkonzo nganye iya kubuza kwakhona.
serviceSends_google_analytics: Ibala abatyeleli namaphepha afundiweyo. IGoogle ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP kwaye inokubeka iikhukhi.
serviceSends_youtube: Idlala iividiyo ezivela kuYouTube. IGoogle ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP kwaye inokubeka iikhukhi.
serviceSends_vimeo: Idlala iividiyo ezivela kuVimeo. IVimeo ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP; le sayithi iyicela ukuba ingakulandeli.
serviceSends_google_maps: Ibonisa iimephu ezivela kuGoogle Maps. IGoogle ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP kwaye inokubeka iikhukhi.
serviceSends_speech: Xa ibhrawuza yakho ingakwazi ukuqonda intetho kwisixhobo sakho, ilizwi lakho liya kwinkonzo yayo yentetho (Google, Apple okanye Microsoft).
serviceSends_github: Ibonisa amakhadi eendawo zokugcina ikhowudi nomnye umxholo ovela kuGitHub. IGitHub ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP kwaye inokubeka iikhukhi.
serviceSends_webstatus: Ibonisa iibheji zenkxaso yebhrawuza ye-Baseline ezivela kwi-webstatus.dev, iprojekthi ye-Google Chrome. IGoogle ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP.
serviceSends_aframe: Ilayisha ithala leencwadi le-A-Frame elivela kwi-aframe.io ukuze ibonise imiboniso ye-3D. I-aframe.io ifumana idilesi yakho ye-IP.
serviceSends_embed: Ibonisa umxholo ovela ku-{host}. U-{host} ufumana idilesi yakho ye-IP kwaye unokubeka iikhukhi.
